title: Momentum Crashes & Dynamic Momentum Weighting (Daniel & Moskowitz)
holding_period: monthly rebalance, overlaid on a 12-month-formation momentum book
signal_frequency: monthly reweighting from conditional mean and variance forecasts
data_requirements: monthly WML / UMD momentum factor returns
CRSP value-weighted market index returns (for the 24-month bear indicator)
long history including 1932 and 2009 - shorter samples miss the crashes entirely
VIX or variance swap data (only for the volatility-exposure analysis)

sources.citation: Daniel, K., & Moskowitz, T. J. (2016). Momentum crashes. Journal of Financial Economics, 122(2), 221-247. Open access, CC BY.
Daniel, K., & Moskowitz, T. J. Momentum Crashes. NBER Working Paper 20439.
Barroso, P., & Santa-Clara, P. (2015). Momentum has its moments. Journal of Financial Economics, 116(1), 111-120. (The constant-volatility benchmark.)
Kenneth R. French Data Library — UMD momentum factor and market returns.
